caption: This miso broth, amber-brown and glossy, holds rich, savory noodles and toppings. In a ceramic bowl with blue and yellow geometric patterns, chashu pork and pale yellow menma sit on a warm wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows browned, slightly crispy exterior with tender, pale interior and visible fat marbling.
The miso broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings, appearing rich and savory.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
The ceramic bowl has a white base, blue and yellow geometric pattern, and a smooth, slightly glossy rim.
